description:
In 2016, Marco Rubio's presidential campaign suffered one of the most memorable collapses in modern American politics. A debate performance that went viral, relentless attacks from Donald Trump, and a crushing defeat in his home state of Florida left many convinced his political future was over.

But it wasn't.

In the years that followed, Rubio quietly rebuilt his influence in Washington, developing a reputation as one of the Senate's most active voices on foreign policy and national security. Nearly a decade after being mocked as “Little Marco,” he found himself standing beside the very man who once ridiculed him.

In this episode, we trace Rubio's journey from the son of Cuban immigrants to rising political star, from public humiliation to political reinvention, and ultimately to becoming one of the most influential figures in American foreign policy. This is a story about resilience, reinvention, and the long road back.

title: From “Marco Robot” to Secretary of State: The Remarkable Comeback of Marco Rubio I China Insights
